# Patch And Training Requirements Checklist: Splat Patching And Training

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for splat outlier filtering, patch generation, patch reuse, and LFS training before task generation and implementation  
**Created**: 2026-06-11  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the required completed SfM inputs fully specified, including undistorted images, undistorted sparse data, undistorted intrinsics, and image-name matching expectations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Data Model §SplatSourceReconstruction]
- [ ] CHK002 Are outlier filtering requirements complete for enabled, disabled, dry-run, no-removal, removal, and ambiguous-removal outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §US2, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-036, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK003 Are patch-generation requirements complete for patch bounds, selected cameras, selected images, sparse export, metadata, diagnostics, and invalid patch handling? [Completeness, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 Are patch training requirements complete for all-patch training, selected patch IDs, serial execution, completion classification, retraining controls, and patch-level status? [Completeness, Spec §US3, Spec §FR-017 through FR-026, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK005 Are existing-output decisions complete for patch reuse, patch regeneration, training rerun, skip, stop, config differences, and non-interactive failure? [Completeness, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-029 through FR-035]
- [ ] CHK006 Are cleanup, SOG compression, final merging, NanoGS, LOD, PlayCanvas, and mega-patching clearly excluded everywhere this feature defines scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-042, Plan §Summary]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "small, clearly anomalous minority" quantified or tied to a named setting so outlier auto-removal is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036, Data Model §CameraPoseOutlierRecord]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the configured maximum outlier removal fraction named and described clearly enough for users to understand when filtering must stop as ambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-037, Data Model §FilteredReconstruction]
- [x] CHK009 Is "view-based selection" specified with enough observable criteria to distinguish it from simple bird's-eye camera-centre inclusion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the maximum-cameras-per-patch setting described with clear user-facing trade-offs and validation behaviour? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the patch buffer requirement clearly defined as relative scene coordinates and not metric distance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Data Model §SplatConfig Extensions]
- [ ] CHK012 Are "valid patch", "invalid patch", "skipped patch", and "failed patch" states defined with distinct criteria? [Clarity, Data Model §Patch, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 Are training completion status thresholds stated precisely for complete, warning, severe warning, failed, skipped, and not-requested outcomes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022 through FR-024, Data Model §PatchTrainingRun]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Are patch reuse rules consistent between the spec, CLI contract, and data model for training-only changes versus patch-affecting changes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032 through FR-035, CLI Contract §Resume And Reuse, Data Model §PatchReuseDecision]
- [ ] CHK015 Are serial training requirements consistent across the spec, plan constraints, CLI contract, and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, Spec §FR-041, Plan §Technical Context, Data Model §PatchTrainingRun]
- [ ] CHK016 Are source-data safety requirements consistent across outlier filtering, patch export, selected-image access, and training? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §FilteredReconstruction, Data Model §Patch]
- [ ] CHK017 Are diagnostic failure requirements consistent between the spec and data model, especially the distinction between blocking sparse export failures and non-critical diagnostic failures? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §PatchSelectionDiagnostic]
- [x] CHK018 Are stage names and requested step names consistent between the spec, CLI contract, run-record contract, and plan? [Consistency, CLI Contract §Run Selected Splat Substages, Run Record Contract §Status Additions, Plan §Project Structure]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Are success criteria measurable for patch dataset validity, metadata completeness, diagnostics availability, and training status classification? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK020 Can "auditable camera-selection information sufficient for the researcher to decide" be objectively evaluated from the requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the short-iteration LFS smoke-test success criterion specific enough about which artefacts and status fields must be present? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK022 Are resume/overwrite success criteria measurable across patching and training, including when multiple patch decisions are required? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Spec §US4]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are primary flows covered for splat preflight, outlier filtering, patch generation, and patch training as separately requestable stages? [Coverage, Spec §US1 through US4, CLI Contract §Run Selected Splat Substages]
- [ ] CHK024 Are alternate flows covered for dry-run outlier filtering, no-outlier filtering, selected patch training, valid patch reuse, and explicit retraining? [Coverage, Spec §US2, Spec §US3, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK025 Are exception flows covered for missing SfM outputs, missing selected images, sparse export failure, unknown patch IDs, invalid patch requests, LFS failure, and missing decisions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, CLI Contract §Exit Behaviour]
- [ ] CHK026 Are recovery flows covered for partially generated patches, partial LFS outputs, under-completed training, and config differences across resumed runs? [Coverage, Spec §US3, Spec §US4, Run Record Contract §Warning Events]
- [ ] CHK027 Are non-interactive run requirements clear for every condition that would otherwise prompt the user? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for reconstructions where outlier scoring indicates multiple clusters or widespread localisation problems rather than a few isolated outliers? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for patch size settings that are too restrictive to produce useful patches? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK030 Are requirements defined for patches with sparse points but too few selected images, or selected images but no useful sparse support? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Data Model §Patch]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for training when some requested patches are invalid but others are valid? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK032 Are requirements defined for LFS progress parsing failures without conflating parser failure with training failure? [Edge Case, Run Record Contract §Warning Events, Data Model §PatchTrainingRun]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK033 Are observability requirements complete for pipeline logs, LFS logs, patch-level status, warnings, and timings without requiring terminal-output parsing? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-028, Run Record Contract §Timings Additions]
- [ ] CHK034 Are data-safety requirements explicit enough to prevent raw images, source SfM outputs, and the only source reconstruction copy from being modified in place? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK035 Are performance and scale assumptions documented for thousands of images, user-selected patch size, one-patch-at-a-time training, and no automatic GPU-fit calculation? [Non-Functional, Plan §Scale/Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Are public-path and local-machine secrecy requirements covered for generated configs, docs, run records, and diagnostics? [Non-Functional, Constitution, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Are external dependency assumptions for COLMAP outputs, LichtFeld Studio `v0.5.2`, and `pycolmap` availability stated in the correct documents? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK038 Are assumptions about Feature 1 run records and Feature 2 undistorted outputs reflected consistently in the spec and plan? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK039 Are user responsibilities for choosing maximum cameras per patch documented clearly enough to avoid implying automatic VRAM sizing? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Scale/Scope]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK040 Is there any remaining ambiguity between "reuse", "resume", "overwrite", "regenerate", "retrain", "skip", and "stop" across patching and training decisions? [Ambiguity, Spec §US4, Data Model §PatchReuseDecision]
- [ ] CHK041 Is it clear whether outlier filtering is mandatory, enabled-by-default but disableable, or always run before patching unless explicitly bypassed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, CLI Contract §Run Full Splat Patching And Training]
- [ ] CHK042 Is it clear which diagnostics are mandatory for a valid patch and which are optional warning-only artefacts? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014 through FR-016, Data Model §PatchSelectionDiagnostic]
